outcome: Vaginal delivery (VD) within 24 hours of induction
Vaginal delivery greater than 24 hours after induction
cohort: The study included 268 nulliparous singleton women who underwent cervical length screening at 18-23 weeks gestation and were subsequently induced at term (>=37 weeks).
finding: A second-trimester cervical length greater than 40 mm was associated with a decreased likelihood of vaginal delivery within 24 hours in an induction of labor.
mod_finding: A longer second-trimester cervical length, particularly >40 mm, was associated with a decreased likelihood of achieving vaginal delivery within 24 hours following induction of labor.
gest_age: Exposure measured at 18 0/7-23 6/7 weeks; induction at >=37 weeks
